title: Untouched holdout test set
evidence: 20% stratified/grouped holdout evaluated once per task
impact: Holdout metrics are unbiased for fixed dev selection

title: Model-family selection reuses the reported OOF metric
evidence: 8 candidates, champion = argmin penalised OOF MAE; mitigated by 20% untouched holdout
impact: Mild optimistic bias on OOF, largest for N=44

title: Task 3 labels are produced by the deterministic engine
evidence: target = EnvironmentalResult/EconomicResult output (generate_simulated_scenario_dataset)
impact: Metrics measure engine-copy fidelity, not real-world accuracy
mitigation: Disclosed in model card; executive UI uses the exact engine, never the surrogate

title: Task 3 circular target-mirror features
evidence: expected_bom_material_spend and expected_spoilage_gwp removed from Task 3 features
impact: Surrogate learns from physical/operational inputs only

title: Task 2 has only 44 observations
evidence: champion OOF MAE 0.174 with fold std 0.104 (std > mean)
impact: Performance estimate has very wide uncertainty
mitigation: Do not use for decisions; collect more cheeses

title: Training data are France/US/EU; deployment goal is Central Asia
evidence: AGRIBALYSE/PDO geography = FR only; resin factors US/EU/CN/MENA; UI grid presets include Uzbekistan
impact: Factors may not transfer to Uzbek supply chains
mitigation: Collect local plant data; label outputs as FR-based

title: Reference years span 2007-2025 and no observation date exists
evidence: packaging factor reference_year values: 2007, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2018, 2020/2024, 2022/2024, 2024; PDO tables 2020-2022
impact: Cannot test temporal drift; mixed vintages

title: Task 1 sample dominated by cheese
evidence: cheese = 47% of 255 core AGRIBALYSE products
impact: Performance on other categories is less certain

title: PDO cheeses are specialty products
evidence: 44 PDO cheeses only; INAO-regulated technologies
impact: Not representative of industrial cheese
mitigation: State scope in every PDO output

title: Dairy categories absent from simulator training set
evidence: core categories without simulated rows: none
impact: Surrogate cannot be trusted for missing categories

title: Many LCA factors are typed literals; part are proxies
evidence: 42% of 65 packaging factors are source_type=proxy; GWP/energy/water values for USLCI polymers are literals in harmonize.py, not computed from raw JSON
impact: Exact-looking numbers may not trace to raw files
mitigation: Compute factors from raw data or cite the page/table per literal

title: Density assigned by category rule
evidence: _infer_dairy_density returns one value per category
impact: Density is a redundant proxy of category

title: Task 1 co-computed LCIA indicator leakage
evidence: Co-computed LCIA midpoint indicators and stage GWPs are blocked by FORBIDDEN_LEAKAGE_COLUMNS
impact: Task 1 uses pre-LCA attributes only

title: preset_id / category act as identity proxies
evidence: preset_id nearly determines package BOM in Task 3
impact: Model may memorise presets rather than physics

title: Executive presets vs simulator training ranges
evidence: 0 preset/feature values outside the simulated range: []
impact: Out-of-range scenarios extrapolate
mitigation: Widen generator ranges or block predictions

title: No drift or performance monitoring
evidence: code scan for 'drift'/'monitor' outside audit layer: 1 hits
impact: Silent degradation after data refresh

title: Historical training metadata not recorded
evidence: No VCS commit, training duration, dependency versions or experiment IDs existed before this audit layer
impact: Past results cannot be exactly reproduced
mitigation: Use the experiment tracker from now on; initialise git

title: No calibrated prediction intervals
evidence: Only empirical OOF absolute-error quantiles are available
impact: Users may over-read point predictions

title: Near-duplicate feature vectors across folds
evidence: task3a_surrogate_gwp: 0 validation rows have an exact feature-vector twin in their training fold; task3b_surrogate_cost: 0 validation rows have an exact feature-vector twin in their training fold; task1_agribalyse_gwp: 76 validation rows have an exact feature-vector twin in their training fold; task2a_pdo_cheese_total: 0 validation rows have an exact feature-vector twin in their training fold; task2b_pdo_cheese_post_farm: 0 validation rows have an exact feature-vector twin in their training fold
impact: Slightly optimistic CV

title: Importance/attribution methods are not causal
evidence: Permutation importance with correlated features; local attribution is marginal replacement, not exact SHAP
impact: Misreading as causal drivers
mitigation: State limitation next to every chart
